issues.detail: Several steps defer to external docs instead of being specified (multi-turn conversation input format, polling a background job 'by response id' with no code, 'check the models page', unverified error class names), and the model id 'openai/gpt-5.6-sol' is unexplained.

Error handling covers only 429 rate limits; there is no handling for auth failures, timeouts, empty search_results, or background job failure, and the retry example relies on an error class the skill itself says to verify.

scenarios.name: migrate-sonar-chat-completions
scenarios.rationale: B uses responses.create with input, max_output_tokens, a preset, the recency filter inside the web_search tool's filters, and response.output_text, so it meets every rubric item and honestly flags the unverified filter key; A keeps the old chat.completions call and fails the rubric entirely.

scenarios.name: cited-research-with-sources
scenarios.rationale: A uses client.responses.create with preset='low', input=, prints response.output_text, and iterates response.search_results for title and url, matching the rubric; B uses the forbidden /chat/completions endpoint via raw requests and so fails the core requirement.

scenarios.name: long-research-background-job
scenarios.rationale: B matches the rubric: preset 'high' with background=True, a note to poll by response id, and a preset='fast' stream=True loop that prints event.delta on response.output_text.delta, with only the retrieval call left out. A uses the older sonar-deep-research async API with reasoning_effort, has no presets, no background=True, and no event-type streaming.
